entries.summary: Eberhardus de Riedern, decanus ecclesiae herbipolensis, ultimae voluntatis suae executores constituit.
entries.latin:
Jn nomine domini, amen. Nos Eberhardus de Riedern,
decanus ecclesie herbjpolensis, sanus mente et corpore, certus
de morte, licet incertus de tempore et hora mortis, nolentes
intestatus decedere, sed de bonis et rebus nobis a diuina bonitate
concessis seu concedendis cupientes pro anime nostre salute dis-
ponere et disponi, jdcirco honorabiles viros Lupoldum de
Bebenburk, Eberhardum de Hirtzhorn, Theodricum de
Maspach, Johannem de Rosenberg et Ernestum de
Ristenhusen, canonicos in dicta nostra ecclesia herbipolensi,
et Eberhardum de Bopphingen, custodem ecclesie Noui-
monasterij herbipolensis, et quemlibet eorum in solidum in
nostros eligimus fidecommissarios et nostri testamenti seu nostre
vltime voluntatis executores constituimus in hijs scriptis, dantes
ipsis et cuilibet eorum in solidum potestatem plenariam, se de
bonis et rebus a nobis relictis seu relinquendis intromittendi, per-
cipiendi, exigendi, repetendi et de ipsis disponendi, prout eis in
scriptis aut verbis mandauerimus. Et si de ipsis bonis et rebus
nostris aut aliquibus eorum non disponeremus, aut nostram volun-
tatem circa ipsa uel ipsas specialiter non exprimeremus, volumus
et ipsis concedimus potestatem disponendi de bonis et rebus huius-
modj, prout eis pro salute anime nostre videbitur expedire. Et
si presens nostra ordinatio seu disposicio non valet ut testamen-
tum, volumus, ut valeat jure codicilli seu cuiuslibet vltime volun-
tatis. Nolumus tamen, ipsos fidecommissarios nostros ad plus
teneri, quam in bonis nostris valeant inuenire et habere. Jn
premissorum omnium et singulorum testimonium presens scriptum
sigillo honorabilis viri domini . . officialis curie herbipolensis
petiuimus et obtinuimus roborari; et nichilominus per manum
Conradi de Nordelingen, publici jmperiali auctoritate notarij
infrascripti, conscribi fecimus ipsiusque signo solito consignari.
Porro nos . . officialis curie herbipolensis predictus recognos-
cimus, nos sigillum officialitatis nostre ad preces dicti domini
Eberhardj decani in premissorum testimonium presentibus
appendisse.
Acta sunt hec, ut premittitur, jn ciuitate herbipolensi,
jn domo seu loco capitulari dicte herbipolensis ecclesie, sub
anno dominj millesimo CCCo Lmo, die tercia mensis aprilis, hora
VIa, presentibus honorabilibus viris, dominis Alberto de Ebers-
perg, scolastico, Gotfrido de Nidecke, Johanne pincerna de Erpach,
Engelhardo de Bebenburg, Johanne de Salczberg et Johanne de
Brenden, canonicis capitularibus predicte ecclesie herbipolensis,
ad premissa vocatis pro testibus et rogatis.
Et ego Conradus de Nordelingen, augustensis dyocesis, pub-
licus jmperiali auctoritate notarius, quia huiusmodj fidecommissari-
orum constitucioni et alijs predictis vna cum dictis testibus presens
interfui eaque vidi sic fieri et audiui, jdeo hoc jnstrumentum ad
mandatum et requisicionem dicti domini decani propria manu
conscripsi signoque meo solito signaui in testimonium omnium
premissorum.
entries.english: In the name of the Lord, amen. We, Eberhard von Riedern, dean of the church of Würzburg, sound in mind and body, certain of death though uncertain of the time and hour of death, not wishing to die intestate but desiring to dispose, and to have disposed, for the salvation of our soul, of the goods and things granted or yet to be granted to us by divine goodness, therefore choose the honourable men Leopold von Bebenburg, Eberhard von Hirtzhorn, Dietrich von Maspach, Hans von Rosenberg and Ernst von Ristenhusen, canons in our said church of Würzburg, and Eberhard von Bopfingen, custos of the church of Neumünster in Würzburg, and each of them in full, as our trustees (fidecommissarii), and by this writing appoint them executors of our will or last testament, giving them and each of them in full plenary power to take charge of, receive, demand and reclaim the goods and things left or to be left by us, and to dispose of them as we shall have instructed them in writing or by word. And if we should not dispose of these goods and things, or some of them, or should not expressly state our will concerning them, we wish and grant them power to dispose of such goods and things as shall seem expedient to them for the salvation of our soul. And if this our ordinance or disposition is not valid as a testament, we wish it to be valid by the right of a codicil or of any last will. We do not wish, however, that our trustees be held liable beyond what they can find and have in our goods. In testimony of all and each of the foregoing we asked for and obtained that the present writing be strengthened with the seal of the honourable man, the lord [name omitted], official of the court of Würzburg; and we likewise had it written by the hand of Konrad von Nördlingen, public notary by imperial authority, named below, and marked with his usual sign. Furthermore, we, the aforesaid [name omitted], official of the court of Würzburg, acknowledge that at the request of the said lord Eberhard the dean we have attached the seal of our office to this document in testimony of the foregoing. This was done, as stated above, in the city of Würzburg, in the chapter house of the said church of Würzburg, in the year of the Lord 1350, on the third day of April, at the sixth hour, in the presence of the honourable men, lords Albrecht von Ebersberg, scholaster, Gotfried von Niedeck, Johann Schenk von Erbach, Engelhard von Bebenburg, Johann von Salzberg and Johann von Brenden, capitular canons of the said church of Würzburg, called and asked as witnesses to the foregoing. And I, Konrad von Nördlingen, of the diocese of Augsburg, public notary by imperial authority, was present together with the said witnesses at this appointment of trustees and the other things mentioned, saw them done and heard them, and therefore wrote this instrument with my own hand at the order and request of the said lord dean and marked it with my usual sign in testimony of all the foregoing.
